text: There are three types of mental modifications (samskaras): impulse (vega), emotion (bhavana), and stabilizing force (sthiti-sthapaka). Impulse is the mental modification that moves the four elements—earth, water, fire, and air. Emotion is the mental modification that arises from experience and serves as the cause of memory. The stabilizing force is the mental modification that, in a being whose nature has been altered, restores that being to its original state; it is the mental modification of the earth element and the like. || 64 ||
